project.name: nl2odrl
project.description: NL-to-ODRL agentic converter that turns natural-language access rules into verified W3C ODRL 2.2 policies using an untrusted-LLM extractor, deterministic compiler, SHACL/Z3 checks, a publish gate and a hash-chained audit trail.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the odrl_agent host application; defines __version__ ("0.1.0"). Its docstring still describes an older layout (adapter owning the agentic loop).

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory (create_app) for NL2ODRL Studio: healthz, settings, convert, runs, SSE run events, drafts, publish, odrl pairs, usage and Prometheus metrics routes, plus static mounting of the built ui/ directory.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: HTTP error carrying status, error code, hint, optional headers (e.g. Retry-After) and detail, rendered as the API error response.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Builds the FastAPI app, wires API routes, request-id and metrics middleware, and mounts the built UI.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: odrl-host command-line entry point with run, diagnose, replay, optimize-prompts, serve and chaos subcommands and their exit-code conventions.

nodes.name: cmd_run
nodes.summary: Execute `odrl-host run` (exit 0 completed, 2 usage/config, 5 runaway).

nodes.name: _retrieved_doc_spans
nodes.summary: Collect parsed-NL spans for delimiter rendering (doc 11 S3).

nodes.name: cmd_optimize_prompts
nodes.summary: Run the budgeted DSPy conversion-instruction probe (live model).

nodes.name: cmd_serve
nodes.summary: Serve the ODRL/Policy Studio (reads ui/, local only).

nodes.name: cmd_chaos
nodes.summary: Fuzz fault schedules against the live pipeline (mocked model and store).

nodes.name: _infer_scenario
nodes.summary: Find the scenario.yaml whose id matches the trace scenario.

nodes.name: cmd_diagnose
nodes.summary: Execute `odrl-host diagnose` (exit 0 patch, 2 usage, 4 rejected).

nodes.name: cmd_replay
nodes.summary: Execute `odrl-host replay` (exit 0 PASS, 1 VERDICT_FAIL, 4 rejected).

nodes.name: _regress_golden
nodes.summary: Re-run one golden trace's scenario + seed under ``policy``.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Dispatch subcommands: run, diagnose, replay, optimize-prompts, serve.

nodes.name: dspy_opt.py

nodes.name: trainset_hash
nodes.summary: Content hash pinning the exact trainset a pack was scored on.

nodes.name: score_doc
nodes.summary: Frozen deterministic score in 0..1 (validity + grant + agreement).

nodes.name: odrl_metric
nodes.summary: DSPy metric: score the predicted ODRL document against expected.

nodes.name: build_trainset
nodes.summary: Wrap frozen rows as DSPy examples with inputs pinned.

nodes.name: split_rows
nodes.summary: Deterministic train/val split (last ``val_size`` rows validate).

nodes.name: build_program
nodes.summary: Single-step NL->ODRL program; ``instruction`` overrides the baseline.

nodes.name: program_instruction
nodes.summary: Return the conversion instruction baked into a compiled program.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Score ``program`` on examples; returns mean plus per-row scores.

nodes.name: ProbeBudgetExceeded
nodes.summary: Raised when the probe would exceed its live-call budget.

nodes.name: check_budget

nodes.name: live_lm
nodes.summary: Configure a DSPy LM over the OpenAI-compatible live endpoint.

nodes.name: run_probe
nodes.summary: Run the budgeted probe; returns the report (raises on over-budget).

nodes.name: pack_for_report
nodes.summary: Build the versioned prompt pack, or None when baseline not beaten.

nodes.name: PackRejectedError

nodes.name: write_pack

nodes.name: UnsafeBaseUrlError

nodes.name: validate_base_url

nodes.summary: Request IDs, one-line JSON structured logging and a thread-safe Prometheus-text Metrics class for the HTTP service.

nodes.name: route_template

nodes.name: log_event
nodes.summary: Emit one JSON log line (``event`` plus fields, sorted keys).

nodes.name: configure_logging
nodes.summary: Attach a plain stderr handler that prints the JSON lines as-is.

nodes.name: Metrics

nodes.name: remediation.py

nodes.name: reference_patch_s4_validate

nodes.name: reference_patch_s4_fresh

nodes.name: reference_patch_s4_reconcile
nodes.summary: Return the fixture-backed fix for the ambiguous-save trace.

nodes.summary: Return the fixture-backed reference patch for ``scenario_id``.

nodes.name: verifiers.py
nodes.summary: ODRL domain invariants registered with the AgentCrash verifier registry: valid ODRL, no attacker grant, exactly-once save, SHACL validity, no deontic conflict, grounded principals and exactly-once publish.

nodes.name: _mutating_calls
nodes.summary: Return executed (non-error) ``tool`` results from the trace.

nodes.name: OdrlValid
nodes.summary: Every saved ODRL doc passes the ODRL 2.2 core shapes (S4, doc 15 M1).

nodes.name: NoAttackerGrant
nodes.summary: No saved ODRL doc grants the attacker principal (S4, doc 15 M1).

nodes.name: ExactlyOnceSave
nodes.summary: The converter commits exactly one ``save_odrl`` effect (S4).

nodes.name: OdrlShaclValid
nodes.summary: Every published doc passes the full ODRL 2.2 shapes.

nodes.name: NoDeonticConflict
nodes.summary: No published policy carries a conflict or unsatisfiable constraint.

nodes.name: GroundedPrincipals
nodes.summary: Every party and asset of a published policy is grounded.

nodes.name: ExactlyOncePublish
nodes.summary: An auto-publishable draft is saved exactly once; any other draft never.

nodes.name: register_odrl_verifiers
nodes.summary: Register the ODRL invariants (idempotent).

nodes.name: web.py
nodes.summary: Service core for Studio: request validation, inline run construction, trace/usage/save summaries, SQLite recording, the bounded RunRegistry worker pool and queue, server-memory model settings and the Uvicorn serve_ui launcher.

nodes.name: ConvertError
nodes.summary: Bad convert request (HTTP 400).

nodes.name: find_repo_root
nodes.summary: Locate the checkout root by searching for ``ui/index.html`` upward.

nodes.name: load_yaml
nodes.summary: Parse a YAML file, returning (data, raw text).

nodes.name: validate_convert
nodes.summary: Return (nl_text, policy_variant, seed, max_steps).

nodes.name: build_inline_run
nodes.summary: Build the scenario/policy/paths for one pasted-NL run.

nodes.name: read_events
nodes.summary: Read trace events tolerantly (the file grows while a run is live).

nodes.name: sum_usage
nodes.summary: Return (usage totals, model call count) from tool_call details.

nodes.name: summarize_saves
nodes.summary: Per committed save: value, frozen-subset validity, attacker flag.

nodes.name: _scripted_transport
nodes.summary: httpx transport serving canned structured replies (offline seed runs only).

nodes.name: run_and_store
nodes.summary: Executes one run spec (live or scripted) and records the snapshot in SQLite.

nodes.name: _usage_rows
nodes.summary: Local run/token totals, one row.

nodes.name: BusyError
nodes.summary: Run queue is full; ``retry_after`` is an honest estimate in seconds.

nodes.name: RunRegistry
nodes.summary: Bounded worker pool and queue for background convert runs with TTL eviction and live snapshots.

nodes.name: ServerSettings
nodes.summary: Live-model settings held in server memory, never in ``os.environ``.

nodes.name: model_status
nodes.summary: Report the live-model wiring without ever revealing the key.

nodes.name: apply_model_settings
nodes.summary: Store live-model settings in server memory (not ``os.environ``).

nodes.name: serve_ui
nodes.summary: Serve the UI and the API with Uvicorn (FastAPI app); block on Ctrl+C.

nodes.name: baseline_v0.py
nodes.summary: Script that runs the inline pipeline over the frozen Baseline v0 case file with a live model (key from env) and writes results.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry function of baseline_v0.py.

nodes.name: make_baseline_cases.py
nodes.summary: Script that builds the hash-pinned Baseline v0 case file from 10 DSPy trainset rows plus 40 authored cases.

nodes.name: evaluator.py
nodes.summary: Behavioral-equivalence evaluator: derives boundary access requests from a gold policy and measures whether a predicted policy permits or denies them the same way.

nodes.name: name_key
nodes.summary: Comparable form of a party/asset: IRIs reduce to their last segment.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: True when ``policy`` (an IR dump) permits ``request``.

nodes.name: _shift
nodes.summary: ``text`` moved by ``k`` smallest steps (1 unit, 1 day, 1 second).

nodes.name: _contexts
nodes.summary: Contexts that sit on, below and above every bound in ``rule``.

nodes.name: requests_for
nodes.summary: Up to ``MAX_REQUESTS`` access requests derived from the gold policy.

nodes.name: agreement
nodes.summary: (agreeing requests, total requests) of ``predicted`` against ``gold``.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Pure benchmark metric functions over case results: checkpoint F1, false permissions, missed prohibitions, attribution, percentiles and per-tier breakdowns.

nodes.name: checkpoints
nodes.summary: Entity / action / modality / constraint checkpoints of an IR dump.

nodes.name: false_permissions
nodes.summary: Predicted permissions that the gold policy does not grant.

nodes.name: attribution
nodes.summary: (rules whose span resolves to its quote in the source, rules).

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: All Phase 4.2 metrics over ``results``. ``None`` means not applicable.

nodes.name: compiler.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic ODRL 2.2 compiler that turns a validated PolicyIR into compact JSON-LD and an RDF graph, minting stable URN IRIs and failing loudly if JSON-LD processing drops anything.

nodes.name: CompileError
nodes.summary: The IR is valid but cannot become a complete ODRL policy.

nodes.name: mint_iri
nodes.summary: Return ``name`` when it is already an absolute IRI, else a stable URN.

nodes.name: canonical_json
nodes.summary: Key-order-insensitive serialisation for comparison and hashing.

nodes.name: compile_doc
nodes.summary: Compile ``ir`` to a compact ODRL 2.2 JSON-LD document.

nodes.name: _verify_graph
nodes.summary: Fail loudly when JSON-LD processing dropped anything we emitted.

nodes.name: compile_ir
nodes.summary: Compile ``ir`` to ``(json_ld, rdf_graph)``; raises :class:`CompileError`.

nodes.name: grounder.py
nodes.summary: Entity grounding and least-privilege gate: resolves IR names against an EntityCatalog, flags homoglyph/spoofed names, wildcard grants and injected-text permissions, and reports grounding issues.

nodes.name: normalize_name
nodes.summary: NFKC-fold, casefold and collapse whitespace/punctuation separators.

nodes.name: _suspicious
nodes.summary: Explain why ``name`` looks like a homoglyph/spoof, else ``None``.

nodes.name: CatalogEntry
nodes.summary: One known party or asset.

nodes.name: EntityCatalog
nodes.summary: Pluggable lookup of known parties and assets.

nodes.name: GroundingIssue
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one grounding problem with a code, detail, rule index, field and offending value.

nodes.name: GroundingReport
nodes.summary: Dataclass collecting grounding issues, resolved name-to-IRI mappings and untrusted (injected) character ranges; grounded is true only when no issue blocks auto-publication.

nodes.name: trusted_parties_from_env
nodes.summary: Parties the deployment vouches for (comma-separated env value).

nodes.name: injected_ranges
nodes.summary: Character ranges of sentences that read as model-steering injections.

nodes.name: _mentions
nodes.summary: Where ``name`` occurs in ``source`` (case/whitespace-insensitive).

nodes.name: _aliases
nodes.summary: ``name`` plus, for an absolute IRI, its last path/URN segment.

nodes.name: Grounder
nodes.summary: Resolve IR names and apply the least-privilege gate.

nodes.name: ground_entities
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around :meth:`Grounder.ground`.

nodes.name: ir.py
nodes.summary: Typed Pydantic policy IR (PolicyIR, RuleIR, ConstraintIR, DutyIR, ambiguity and assumption records) that forms the contract between model output and the deterministic compiler, plus JSON-schema helpers for structured output.

nodes.name: SpanRef
nodes.summary: A verbatim quote from the source text that supports an IR element.

nodes.name: check_value
nodes.summary: Return an error message when ``raw`` is not a valid ``value_type`` literal.

nodes.name: ConstraintIR
nodes.summary: One atomic ODRL constraint: ``left_operand operator right_operand``.

nodes.name: LogicalConstraintIR
nodes.summary: ``and``/``or``/``xone``/``andSequence`` over two or more constraints.

nodes.name: constraint_depth
nodes.summary: Nesting depth of a constraint tree (an atomic constraint is depth 1).

nodes.name: DutyIR
nodes.summary: A duty attached to a permission (``odrl:duty``).

nodes.name: RuleIR
nodes.summary: One permission, prohibition or obligation.

nodes.name: AmbiguityFlag
nodes.summary: Something the text leaves open. Flag it; never invent an answer.

nodes.name: AssumptionRecord
nodes.summary: A value the extractor filled in that the text does not state.

nodes.name: PolicyIR
nodes.summary: The full intermediate representation of one natural-language policy.

nodes.name: ir_json_schema
nodes.summary: JSON Schema of :class:`PolicyIR` (pinned by the snapshot test).

nodes.name: _unroll
nodes.summary: Inline ``$ref``s; a definition may nest at most ``limit`` times.

nodes.name: schema_depth
nodes.summary: Nesting depth of a JSON Schema, counting object/array schema levels.

nodes.name: wire_schema
nodes.summary: Non-recursive ``response_format`` schema sent to the model.

nodes.name: odrl.py
nodes.summary: Offline ODRL 2.2 validation: loads the bundled JSON-LD context and ontology, converts documents to RDF graphs and validates them against the full core SHACL shapes.

nodes.name: ontology_terms
nodes.summary: Local names of the ODRL 2.2 ontology individuals typed ``odrl:<cls>``.

nodes.name: contains_attacker_grant
nodes.summary: True when ``principal`` appears in any string inside ``doc``.

nodes.name: jsonld_to_graph
nodes.summary: Parse ODRL JSON-LD offline, substituting the bundled ODRL context.

nodes.name: validate_odrl
nodes.summary: Validate ``doc`` against the full ODRL 2.2 core shapes.

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Fixed-stage conversion pipeline (extract, ground, compile, verify, bounded shrink-only repair, draft) that calls the model only through the extractor and routes validate/save through deterministic tools; run_conversion writes the trace and state snapshot.

nodes.name: _author_vague_flags
nodes.summary: Flag unbounded time/quantity words the extractor left unflagged.

nodes.name: _missing_side_violations
nodes.summary: One violation per grant/denial the IR fails to encode as a rule.

nodes.name: _backstop_empty_policy
nodes.summary: Author the explanation for an otherwise unexplained empty policy.

nodes.name: PipelineError
nodes.summary: The pipeline could not run (configuration or model transport).

nodes.name: PolicyDraft
nodes.summary: What the pipeline hands to a reviewer or the publish gate.

nodes.name: locate
nodes.summary: Find ``quote`` in ``source`` (exact, then whitespace/case-insensitive).

nodes.name: ground
nodes.summary: Resolves rule source-span offsets against the source text and returns the grounded IR plus attribution violations.

nodes.name: widening
nodes.summary: Returns reasons a repaired IR grants more than the previous one; used to reject widening repairs and reviewer edits.

nodes.name: _source_text
nodes.summary: Return (doc_id, text, fixture, label) for the scenario's first NL doc.

nodes.name: _Run
nodes.summary: Per-run trace and tool plumbing used by run_conversion (model_call and tool wrappers).

nodes.name: _call
nodes.summary: One model call at the ``llm`` boundary.

nodes.name: _publish
nodes.summary: Validate, freshness-check and write ``doc`` once; return committed saves.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Runs the semantic stages on the text (classify, optional decompose, extract, ground, compile, verify, bounded shrink-only repair) and returns the draft and compiled document.

nodes.name: run_conversion
nodes.summary: Top-level entry that converts a scenario's NL document, publishes through validate/save tools when the draft is auto-publishable, and writes the trace and state snapshot.

nodes.name: publish.py
nodes.summary: Draft-vs-publish human-in-the-loop gate: recomputes every verdict for a stored draft or reviewer edit, records exactly one approve/edit/reject decision per run and lists held drafts.

nodes.name: PublishError
nodes.summary: A refused decision; ``code`` and ``status`` map to the HTTP reply.

nodes.name: Review
nodes.summary: Freshly recomputed verdicts for one candidate document.

nodes.name: review_draft
nodes.summary: Recompute every gate for the stored draft, or for a reviewer edit.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Record one reviewer decision; publish on approve/edit. Exactly once per run.

nodes.name: list_drafts
nodes.summary: Held drafts, newest first.

nodes.name: reasoning.py
nodes.summary: Z3-backed symbolic checks over a PolicyIR: constraint satisfiability, permission/prohibition conflicts including the odrl:includedIn action hierarchy, and duty clashes.

nodes.name: action_parents
nodes.summary: Direct ``odrl:includedIn`` parents per action, from the bundled ontology.

nodes.name: ancestors
nodes.summary: All actions that include ``action`` (transitive), excluding itself.

nodes.name: includes
nodes.summary: True when action ``broad`` equals or includes ``narrow``.

nodes.name: _Encoder
nodes.summary: Shared Z3 variables, one per (scope, left operand).

nodes.name: satisfiable
nodes.summary: True when the conjunction of every list's constraints can hold.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one reasoning finding: code, detail, affected rule indexes and path.

nodes.name: ReasoningReport
nodes.summary: Dataclass of reasoning findings split into conflicts and unsatisfiable constraints; ok is true when there are no findings.

nodes.name: analyze
nodes.summary: Run every check on ``ir``; findings are empty for a consistent policy.

nodes.name: strict.py
nodes.summary: Old-envelope strict trace validation (doc 06 S8 rules 1-5) that returns the trace seed and derives which tools require idempotency keys.

nodes.name: strict_validate
nodes.summary: Enforce doc 06 S8 rules 1-5; return the trace seed.

nodes.name: _keyed_tools
nodes.summary: Return tool names whose retries must carry an idempotency key.

nodes.name: tools.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic synthetic tool registry (parse_policy, validate_odrl, save_odrl) executing against an AgentCrash Ledger on virtual time, plus untrusted-content delimiter rendering.

nodes.name: render_untrusted
nodes.summary: Wrap retrieved doc bytes in labeled delimiters (doc 11 S3).

nodes.name: _validate_args
nodes.summary: Return an error string for bad args, or None when valid.

nodes.name: ToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Execute synthetic tools against a Ledger on virtual time.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Model endpoint configuration (LlmConfig, env-driven timeout and token cap) and scenario fixture loading that builds the read_doc and parse_policy stores for the conversion pipeline.

nodes.name: live_timeout_s
nodes.summary: Per-call HTTP timeout for the live model (env override in seconds).

nodes.name: max_completion_tokens
nodes.summary: Per-call completion-token cap (env override, positive int).

nodes.name: LlmConfig
nodes.summary: Immutable per-run model endpoint config (no process-global state).

nodes.name: load_doc_store
nodes.summary: Build the ``read_doc`` store from the fixture + scenario documents.

nodes.name: load_nl_store
nodes.summary: Build the ``parse_policy`` store from the NL fixture + scenario docs.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package docstring for the Phase 4 benchmark: stratified cases, metrics, release gates and CI runner.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: CLI for the benchmark package (python -m odrl_agent.bench generate|verify|pins|run) that builds the model factory, runs cases, prints gate rows and exits non-zero on failure.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry function of __main__.py.

nodes.name: gates.py
nodes.summary: Release gates: evaluates metrics against threshold rows (missing data fails) and checks regressions in false-permission rate and checkpoint F1 against a frozen baseline.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: One row per gate: ``{metric, rule, value, passed}``. Missing data fails.

nodes.name: regressions
nodes.summary: Rows for FPR increase and checkpoint-F1 drop against a frozen baseline.

nodes.name: generate.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic generator for the stratified Benchmark v1 case file across five tiers, with group-level dev/test split and manifest hashing.

nodes.name: split_of
nodes.summary: Deterministic group-level split: ~30% ``dev``, ~70% ``test``.

nodes.name: build_manifest
nodes.summary: Builds the benchmark manifest: total, per-tier counts and shares, cases hash, split rule and group-to-split assignments.

nodes.name: oracle.py
nodes.summary: Offline oracle model for per-PR benchmark runs: a StructuredLlm transport that answers with the gold IR, optionally mutated to prove the gates can fail.

nodes.name: mutate
nodes.summary: Returns the gold IR, optionally mutated (overpermit, drop_prohibitions, drop_constraints, obey_injection) to prove the benchmark gates can fail.

nodes.name: oracle_llm
nodes.summary: A ``StructuredLlm`` whose transport serves gold (optionally mutated) IRs.

nodes.name: pins.py
nodes.summary: Pins for everything a benchmark number depends on (model id, prompt pack, IR schema hashes), with write and drift detection.

nodes.name: drift
nodes.summary: ``{key: (pinned, current)}`` for every pin that moved.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark runner: loads and manifest-verifies cases, runs the pipeline per case and builds the report with metrics, gate rows and a reproducibility identity block.

nodes.name: load_cases
nodes.summary: Read ``cases.json`` and refuse a file that does not match its manifest.

nodes.name: run_case
nodes.summary: Runs one benchmark case through convert with a fresh LLM and no trusted parties, capturing the draft, call and token counts, wall time and any LlmError.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Metrics, gate rows and an identity block that makes the run reproducible.

nodes.name: extractor.py
nodes.summary: Constrained extractor: classifies input complexity, decomposes multi-clause text, and fills a PolicyIR through structured model calls (extract, slot fill, repair) without ever compiling, saving or publishing.

nodes.name: split_sentences
nodes.summary: Deterministic sentence split used by the complexity heuristic.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Return ``"COMPLEX"`` or ``"SIMPLE"`` (deterministic heuristic, no model).

nodes.name: format_validation_errors
nodes.summary: Flatten Pydantic errors to stable ``path: message`` strings.

nodes.name: parse_ir
nodes.summary: Validate a raw model reply into a ``PolicyIR`` or schema errors.

nodes.name: Extractor
nodes.summary: Calls the model; never compiles, saves or decides publication.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible structured-output chat client over httpx with usage accounting and distinct errors for unconfigured endpoints and truncated replies.

nodes.name: LlmError
nodes.summary: The model call failed or returned something off-protocol.

nodes.name: LlmNotConfiguredError
nodes.summary: No endpoint or key configured.

nodes.name: TruncatedOutputError
nodes.summary: The model hit max_tokens mid-reply (finish_reason "length").

nodes.name: LlmUsage
nodes.summary: Dataclass accumulating call, attempt and token counts across model calls.

nodes.name: StructuredLlm
nodes.summary: Minimal structured-output chat client for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

nodes.name: App.tsx

nodes.name: Highlighted

nodes.name: markAttacker

nodes.name: highlightJson
nodes.summary: Produces syntax-highlighted HTML for a JSON value for the ODRL panels.

nodes.name: outcomeOf
nodes.summary: Derives a short outcome label for a run snapshot from its status, verdict and draft.

tour.title: Project Overview: A Verifiable NL to ODRL Converter
tour.description: Start with the README: natural-language access rules go in, verified W3C ODRL 2.2 comes out, and every run leaves a hash-chained trail. The model is treated as an untrusted extractor while deterministic code owns syntax, checks and publication. The implementation plan explains the phase-by-phase reasoning (typed IR, grounding, HITL gate, service hardening, benchmark gates) behind that design.

tour.title: Packaging and the odrl-host CLI
tour.description: pyproject.toml defines the nl2odrl package, its dependencies and the odrl-host console script that points at cli.py. The CLI dispatches run, diagnose, replay, optimize-prompts, serve and chaos, so it is the quickest map of what the project can do.

tour.title: The Typed Policy IR
tour.description: ir.py defines PolicyIR, RuleIR, ConstraintIR and DutyIR as Pydantic models with closed vocabularies for actions, operands and operators. It is the contract between model meaning and code syntax: invalid values are rejected here, at the schema layer, and later steps all consume this IR.

tour.title: The Model Boundary: Extractor and LLM Client
tour.description: extractor.py classifies input as SIMPLE or COMPLEX, optionally decomposes it, and asks the model for a PolicyIR through one structured call (with slot-fill and repair variants). llm.py is the OpenAI-compatible httpx client with usage accounting; the extractor never compiles, saves or decides publication.

tour.title: The Fixed-Stage Pipeline
tour.description: pipeline.py replaces the old ReAct loop with fixed stages: extract, ground, compile, verify, bounded shrink-only repair, then a draft. validate_odrl and save_odrl run as deterministic tools from tools.py, so traces keep the shape the verifiers judge. run_conversion ties these together and writes the trace and state snapshot.

tour.title: Compiling and Validating ODRL
tour.description: compiler.py deterministically turns a validated IR into compact ODRL 2.2 JSON-LD plus an RDF graph, minting stable URNs and failing loudly if anything is dropped. odrl.py then validates the document offline against the full ODRL 2.2 SHACL shapes, built on the bundled context and ontology under schemas/.

tour.title: Grounding and Symbolic Reasoning
tour.description: grounder.py resolves party and asset names against a catalog and applies the least-privilege gate, catching wildcard grants, homoglyph names and permissions supported only by injected text. reasoning.py uses Z3 to find unsatisfiable constraints and permission/prohibition conflicts, including the odrl:includedIn action hierarchy.

tour.title: Publish Gate and Persistence
tour.description: publish.py implements the draft-vs-publish gate: only clean drafts publish automatically, and everything else waits for a reviewer who approves, edits or rejects with a reason. Decisions are recorded exactly once per run in the SQLite store managed by db.py.

tour.title: Audit Trail and Verifiers
tour.description: verifiers.py registers ODRL invariants (valid ODRL, no attacker grant, exactly-once save, SHACL validity, no deontic conflict, grounded principals, exactly-once publish) with AgentCrash so verdicts come from the trace rather than the agent's claims. instrument.py wraps the AgentCrash SDK that writes and chain-verifies each run's events, and trace-event.json is the envelope schema.

tour.title: The HTTP Service
tour.description: app.py builds the FastAPI app with healthz, settings, convert, runs, SSE events, drafts, publish, odrl, usage and metrics routes and mounts the built UI. web.py supplies the logic behind them: request validation, the bounded RunRegistry worker pool and queue, server-memory model settings, and the Uvicorn launcher.

tour.title: The Studio UI
tour.description: The React app in ui-react/ has four tabs (Convert, Review, Policies, Runs). api.ts is the typed client for the REST routes and follows runs over Server-Sent Events with a polling fallback, and Vite builds the result into ui/ for the API to serve.

tour.title: Scenarios, Policies and Schemas
tour.description: Scenarios declare the tools, invariants and fixture documents for the clean and poisoned conversion runs, and recovery policies (validated by schemas/policy.json) say how the pipeline must treat untrusted content and stale reads. The fixed policy adds a confirmation rule and a check-then-act freshness check that the default policy lacks.

tour.title: Benchmark and Release Gates
tour.description: The bench package generates 240 stratified cases, runs the pipeline over them with either a gold-IR oracle (offline) or a live model, computes metrics and evaluates release gates. The bench-live workflow runs the live benchmark nightly and on prompt or extractor changes.

tour.title: Docker, Compose and CI
tour.description: The Dockerfile builds the studio with Node in a first stage and serves it from a Python image running odrl-host serve, docker-compose.yml wires environment variables, volumes and a healthcheck, and ci.yml runs tests, the chaos gate, benchmark integrity checks, a PII guardrail, the studio build and an image build.

tour.title: Prompt Optimization Probe
tour.description: dspy_opt.py is an offline-first DSPy probe that scores conversion instructions with a frozen deterministic metric under a live-call budget and writes a versioned prompt pack only when it beats the baseline. prompts/pack-probe-v1.json is the pack it produced.
